description: Returns a saved model's contents in the shape the compute tools take: a cap table's events and options, a waterfall's model and saved exit, a fund's inputs, the features switched on, and featuresSavedButOff (configured but switched off), or a forecast's inputs. Free: uses no calculations. Needs a signed-in connection.

kind.description: "cap-table" (Cap Table builder), "waterfall" (Exit Waterfall builder), "fund" (the web Venture Capital Model), or "unit-economics", "saas-forecasting", "ecommerce-forecasting" (the web models with the same names as their compute tools).

name: get_saved_model
title: Open a saved model
